descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S02 Paste a prior note on a Hospital patient: live extraction updates the chart and takes no vitals

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled … (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 6; TFA-92591 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U2 From an explicitly pasted or photographed prior note, the background, active issues, imaging and diagnostic tests are extracted correctly and update that patient's chart. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U3 Vitals are never taken from a prior note. No vital from the note reaches the Vitals panel, any other panel or today's note. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient (no background, no imaging); live extraction model on the local stack

When Pre-Round → Previous Notes → Paste, date 'Oct 11', type the synthetic note, Save & Extract, collapse the saved note, then open the pre-round notes editor

Then Before the paste, the chart shows none of the note's facts. After Save & Extract the note is saved ('Note · Oct 11') and the chest X-ray effusions are on the chart. No vital from the note (BP 142/88, temp 38.4) appears anywhere on the chart, including Important Points and the pre-round notes editor. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. s02-before mustNotContain the note's facts (baseline). s02-after mustContain 'Oct 11' and 'pleural effusion' and mustNotContain '142/88' and '38.4' with the note collapsed (U3). 'Oct 11' is evidence that the note was saved, not U2 evidence, because the 'Note · Oct 11' toggle supplies it; 'pleural effusion' is the chart-side U2 evidence. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
